name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: New: item and party names must be unique (case-insensitive); duplicate creation is blocked in forms, quick-add flows, and storage
New: app-level error boundary with Reload, Copy Error Details, and a local runtime error log
Improved: paise-safe money rounding across aging, balance sheet, and cash/bank calculations
Improved: credit-note invoice selector lists only the selected party's invoices
Fixed: credit notes recorded as split tenders; WhatsApp balance text and receipt image cropping
